blocks.content: To count the occurrences of a specific digit in an integer, convert the integer to a string, replace all occurrences of the digit with an empty string, and subtract the new string's length from the original string's length.
Let's see a detailed overview of how to solve this problem.

items: Convert the integer to a string using Integer.toString()
Replace all occurrences of the digit with an empty string using replaceAll() method.
Calculate the difference in string length before and after replacement.
